Tkhine for when a Woman Goes to Immerse in the Mikve (1910)

tei:div.tei:head: Tkhine for when a Woman Goes to Immerse in the Mikve (1910)

tei:lg.tei:l: Great God! You performed miracles by water many times: the Righteous Noaḥ was saved from the flood, Moshe our Master was drawn from the water, the Well of Miriam went along with the Jews through the desert [providing] water. Show your miracle today too, [that] I be helped through these waters, to be rewarded with a son who will be wholesomely righteous, who will learn Torah day and night, [and] who will illuminate for me after my long days a straight path into Paradise . In his merit, may I merit to sit with the Matriarchs in one company in the World to Come — Amen.

tei:note.tei:p: also an allusion to reciting Kaddish
